author_or_org: Yifang Tian, Yaming Liu, Zichun Chong, Zihang Huang, Yiran Li, Hans-Arno Jacobsen

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: Microservice root cause analysis requires correlating failures across heterogeneous telemetry within complex service dependency graphs.
claims.quote: Microservice root cause analysis (RCA) requires correlating failures across heterogeneous telemetry within complex service dependency graphs.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: Existing RCA methods often rely on a single telemetry modality; recent LLM-based approaches can suffer from unconstrained exploration and hallucination; and most systems stop at fault ranking without producing actionable incident response.
claims.quote: Existing methods often rely on a single telemetry modality; recent LLM-based approaches can suffer from unconstrained exploration and hallucination; and most systems stop at fault ranking without producing actionable incident response.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: GALA+ is a graph-augmented LLM agentic framework centered on graph-guided investigation that uses service dependencies to bound exploration and refine diagnosis through localized multi-modal evidence.
claims.quote: We present GALA+, a graph-augmented LLM agentic framework centered on graph-guided investigation, which uses service dependencies to bound exploration and refine diagnosis through localized multi-modal evidence.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: For initial hypothesis generation, GALA+ combines complementary telemetry signals with STRIX, a trace- and graph-structure-aware scoring module.
claims.quote: For initial hypothesis generation, GALA+ combines complementary telemetry signals with STRIX, a novel trace- and graph-structure-aware scoring module.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: GALA+ produces ranked diagnoses, incident summaries, and stratified action recommendations.
claims.quote: GALA+ then produces ranked diagnoses, incident summaries, and stratified action recommendations.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: SURE-Score is a human-guided evaluation framework co-developed with industry SRE experts for assessing RCA-specific output quality beyond conventional text similarity metrics.
claims.quote: We further introduce SURE-Score, a human-guided evaluation framework co-developed with industry SRE experts for assessing RCA-specific output quality beyond conventional text similarity metrics.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: On two microservice benchmarks, GALA+ surpassed the best LLM-based baseline by more than 25 percentage points in AC@1 and received the highest ratings from SURE-Score and independent human SRE evaluation.
claims.quote: On two microservice benchmarks, GALA+ consistently achieves the strongest overall results, surpassing the best LLM-based baseline by more than 25 percentage points in AC@1, while also receiving the highest ratings from both SURE-Score and independent human SRE evaluation.
